## Intro

Plot mean and decadal-trend maps of temperature, salinity, and oxygen across the prediction grid. This only needs the prediction grid itself (not any fitted SDM), since it's purely a summary of the raw environmental covariates.

## Load packages & source functions

```{r load libraries}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)

# Source code for map plots
home <- here::here()
source(paste0(home, "/R/functions/map-plot.R"))
options(ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis")
```

## Load data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pred_grid <- bind_rows(
  read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/pred_grid_(1_2).csv")),
  read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/pred_grid_(2_2).csv"))
)
```

## Calculate per-cell means and decadal slopes

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pred_grid <- pred_grid |>
  mutate(id_env = paste(X, Y, sep = "_"), decade = year / 10)

decadal_slope <- function(var) {
  pred_grid |>
    split(pred_grid$id_env) |>
    purrr::map(~ lm(reformulate("decade", var), data = .x)) |>
    purrr::map_df(broom::tidy, .id = "id_env") |>
    filter(term == "decade") |>
    dplyr::select(id_env, estimate)
}

env_vars <- pred_grid |>
  summarise(
    X = first(X), Y = first(Y),
    mean_temp = mean(temp), mean_oxy = mean(oxy), mean_sal = mean(sal),
    .by = id_env
  ) |>
  left_join(decadal_slope("temp") |> rename(temp_slope = estimate), by = "id_env") |>
  left_join(decadal_slope("oxy") |> rename(oxy_slope = estimate), by = "id_env") |>
  left_join(decadal_slope("sal") |> rename(sal_slope = estimate), by = "id_env")
```

## Plot environmental variables

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pal <- brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdYlBu")

pp <- plot_map +
  theme_sleek(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.25, 0.8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "line"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "line"),
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7)
  )

# Because they are on different scales, build with patchwork instead of pivot_longer
p1 <- pp +
  geom_raster(data = env_vars, aes(X * 1000, Y * 1000, fill = mean_temp), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "magma", name = "°C") +
  geom_sf(size = 0.2, color = "grey80") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  annotate("text", label = "SE", x = xmin2 + 0.3 * xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.6 * yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "DK", x = xmin2 + 0.012 * xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.32 * yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "DE", x = xmin2 + 0.07 * xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.02 * yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "PL", x = xmin2 + 0.58 * xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.02 * yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "RU", x = xmin2 + 0.95 * xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.18 * yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "LT", x = xmin2 + 1 * xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.43 * yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "LV", x = xmin2 + 0.99 * xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.65 * yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "(a)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3)

p2 <- pp +
  geom_raster(data = env_vars, aes(X * 1000, Y * 1000, fill = mean_sal), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "cividis", name = "psu") +
  geom_sf(size = 0.2, color = "grey80") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  annotate("text", label = "(b)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3)

p3 <- pp +
  geom_raster(data = env_vars, aes(X * 1000, Y * 1000, fill = mean_oxy), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "mako", name = expression(paste("O"[2], " (ml/L)"))) +
  geom_sf(size = 0.2, color = "grey80") +
  annotate("text", label = "(c)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p4 <- pp +
  geom_raster(data = env_vars, aes(X * 1000, Y * 1000, fill = temp_slope), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "°C/decade", high = pal[11], low = pal[1], breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  geom_sf(size = 0.2, color = "grey80") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  annotate("text", label = "(d)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3)

p5 <- pp +
  geom_raster(data = env_vars, aes(X * 1000, Y * 1000, fill = sal_slope), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "psu/decade", high = pal[11], low = pal[1], breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  geom_sf(size = 0.2, color = "grey80") +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  annotate("text", label = "(e)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3)

p6 <- pp +
  geom_raster(data = env_vars, aes(X * 1000, Y * 1000, fill = oxy_slope), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = expression(paste("O"[2], "/decade")), high = pal[11], low = pal[1], breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0)) +
  geom_sf(size = 0.2, color = "grey80") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  annotate("text", label = "(f)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3)

((p1 + p2 + p3) / (p4 + p5 + p6)) + plot_layout(axes = "collect") &
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/env_vars_space.pdf"), width = 18, height = 11, units = "cm")
```
